text:
emma_support: Escalation: Tideview onboarding stuck during ingestion. We're returning 503/429 bursts; customer says pilot is unusable and mentioned delaying renewal if not fixed today. Escalating to CS for urgent comms and commercial triage. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-92011 | severity=high | service=ingest | triggered_by=rate-throttle
emma_support: Quick logs attached. Observed sudden spike after they pushed full dataset sample.
```
2025-02-11T13:02:12Z ERROR ingest: rateLimitExceeded account=tideview reqs=310 window=30s
2025-02-11T13:02:14Z INFO  ingest: throttle-applied policy=auto-throttle target=ingest_v2
```
ryan_csm: Can we confirm whether Tideview is on shared Growth or Dedicated? They'll want to know if this is our limit or a config bug.
anita_se: They're on Shared Growth. Short-term we can approve a burst quota for 60-90 mins; mid-term: recommend a quota uplift to handle onboarding patterns. I can prepare a minimal request filter to drop noncritical bulk uploads and enable prefix caching.
marc_csm: I'll lead the customer comms. Proposed external note: "Hi Priya — we're seeing transient rate limits on your ingest endpoint during onboarding. We're applying a temporary burst increase and a short rule to deprioritize bulk analytics uploads. Expect restoration within ~1 hour; we'll join a call at 13:45 to review. We'll follow with a timeline and remediation plan." Keep it concise.
emma_support: Added raw request-ids to INC-92011 and linked the realtime dashboard. Also flagged renewals@redwood per the customer's comment.
ryan_csm: Action owners: ryan_csm = schedule call & lead comms, anita_se = implement burst + temp filter, emma_support = logs & dashboard, marc_csm = commercial follow-up.
anita_se: ETA for burst after approvals: ~45-60 minutes. If we can't provision fast enough, we can apply a per-account soft-limit to smooth spikes within 10-15 mins.
marc_csm: I'm drafting a commercial note offering 10% onboarding credit if we don't meet the restoration ETA. Agree?
ryan_csm: Yes add that as a gesture. I'll send the calendar invite for 13:45 and post the customer message in #cust-comm for review.
emma_support: Marked Zendesk ticket as P1 and linked INC-92011. Will update with traffic trends.
marc_csm: On the call I can walk through billing impacts and renewal options. After stabilization, let's capture feedback and add a playbook entry for "onboard-surge" that includes pre-checklist and default burst thresholds.
ryan_csm: Good plan. I'll post the customer-facing message in 5m and loop in renewals. Post-call we'll write the CS playbook entry and attach to the account. :thumbsup:
